_comment: Which fork commit pairs with this repo's state. Same pattern as wowsims.lock.json (plan decision D1). branchedFrom is the upstream commit this fork branch actually sits on -- read it as a fact about the clone, not as a restatement of wowsims.lock.json. As of 2026-09-10 both this file and data/wowsims.lock.json name ec5c5f205e61049d730e460967f8488774a7fe2a on feature/backend-reforge (ADR-0030); ticket 251 is closed with a shape-changed note, since the engine pin moving onto the branch was a fourth option that ticket never contemplated. commit is the fork HEAD this repo's state pairs with, on feat/upgrades-tab at or above the merge commit that brought that upstream commit in, so branchedFrom remains its merge-base with upstream (verified with `git merge-base <commit> <branchedFrom>` in the clone). As of 0b50f402 it is three commits past that merge: a layout-gate fix to test-layout.mjs, which is our own tooling living in the fork tree, not upstream source; a ported-engine edit to upgrades/engine/disclosure.ts with its PROVENANCE sha (ticket 351); and an adapter-only change to upgrades/adapters/sim_database.ts plus its one wiring line in upgrades_tab.tsx, merging the player's item-swap gear into the per-request SimDatabase so a page whose defaults enable item swap no longer panics the sim on an unworn swap item (ticket 362). That last one touches nothing under upgrades/engine, so no PROVENANCE row moved. The clone at clonePath is gitignored (vendor/) and has its own .git pushing to the personal fork. pushed:true records that the branch is on that remote: pushed 2026-09-10 at the owner's explicit ask, a fast-forward d49096e9 -> 0b50f402, verified with `git -C vendor/tbc-new-fork ls-remote origin refs/heads/feat/upgrades-tab` returning this file's commit. That closes ticket 355 -- before the push the pin existed on one disk while data/sim-implemented-effects.json embedded it, so those committed artifacts were unre-derivable anywhere else. Flipping this flag stays a deliberate act: a later fork commit moves commit ahead of the remote again, so re-verify with ls-remote rather than trusting the flag.
